Ajnar, District Mahoba as well as the summoning order dated 26.08.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate Second, Mohaba pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate Second, Mahoba.
3.

which is quoted hereinunder:

"1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Rajeev Kumar Singh, learned Dhirendra And Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 3 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48523856/
1 AGA for the State.

sentences.text:
The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.91 of 2022, Smt. Kalpna Vs. Dhirendra and others, under Sections-498A, 323 IPC and Section-3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Ajnar, District-Mahoba, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, 2nd,
Mahoba, as well as summoning order dated 26.08.2022.

entities.text: Smt. Kalpna Vs. Dhirendra and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Contention of learned counsel for the applicants is that the present proceeding is arising out of the offence which is matrimonial in nature, and therefore, the matter may be referred to the Mediation Centre.

4. Issue notice to opposite party no.2.
5.

In view of the above, the matter is referred to the Mediation Centre, High Court Allahabad, subject to the condition that the applicants will deposit a sum of Rs.35,000/- within two weeks from today with the Mediation Centre, out of which Rs.30,000/- shall be paid to the opposite party no.2 on her appearance before the Mediation Centre on a date to be fixed by the mediation center.

Balance Rs.5,000/-
shall be retained by the mediation center towards its expenses.

6. After depositing the aforesaid amount within aforementioned time, notices shall be issued to the parties fixing some date for mediation and the Mediation Centre shall make all possible efforts to conclude the mediation and conciliation proceedings expeditiously.
7.
List on 17.05.2024 as fresh.

8. It is further provided, if applicants file receipt of deposit of the aforesaid amount before the court below then no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in Complaint Case No.91 of 2022, Smt. Kalpna Vs. Dhirendra and others, under Sections-498A, 323 IPC and Section-3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Ajnar, District-Mahoba, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, 2nd,
Mahoba, till the next date of listing.

entities.text: Smt. Kalpna Vs. Dhirendra and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. It is also made clear that in case the applicants fail to submit the receipt of the aforesaid deposit before the court below then the court below is free to proceed against the applicants."

4. Thereafter another order came to be passed on 17.05.2024, which is quoted hereinunder:
"1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Sunil Kumar Kushwaha, learned A.G.A. for the State.

Dhirendra And Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 3 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48523856/

sentences.text: The instant application has been moved on behalf of the applicants to quash the summoning order dated 26.08.2022 as well as entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.91 of 2022 (Smt. Kalpna Vs. Dhirendra and others), under Sections 498-A, 323 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Ajnar, District Mahoba, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate-II, Mahoba.

entities.text: Complaint Case No.91 of 2022 (Smt. Kalpna Vs. Dhirendra and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. From perusal of order sheet, it appears that on the request of learned counsel for the applicants, this matter was referred to Mediation Centre by order dated 03.05.2024 subject to deposit of Rs.35,000/- within two weeks.

This matter was posted today just to test the bona fide of the applicants, but learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that because of poor condition of applicants the amount as directed by this Court could not be deposited and he seeks further time to deposit the aforesaid amount.
4. Considering the aforesaid request, put up this case on 27.05.2024, as fresh.
5. By that date, applicants will deposit the amount of Rs.35,000/- in compliance of order dated 03.05.2024.

6. It is made clear that if the applicants fail to deposit aforesaid amount, then no further time will be granted to them."
5.
Today, when the matter has been taken up, learned counsel for the applicants submitted that the applicant is not in a position to deposit the amount as directed.
However, he submits that the present application be disposed of granting liberty to the applicant to move an appropriate bail application before the concerned court.
6. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the same.
7. In view of the said fact, the present application is consigned to record leaving it open to the applicants to move appropriate application before the competent court having the jurisdiction.
In case, any such application is made, this Court has no reason to disbelieve that the same will be considered strictly in accordance with law.
